**Location:** Remote Work, DC, US

**Date Posted:** 2026\-08\-19

**Category:** Program Management

**Subcategory:** Program Mgmt

**Schedule:** Full\-Time

**Shift:** Day Job

**Travel:** Yes \- 25% of the time

**Minimum Clearance Required:** None

**Clearance Level Must Be Able to Obtain:** Public Trust

**Potential for Remote Work:** ORA\_REMOTE

 **Description**


SAIC has an opportunity for an FAA Project Manager! The role is remote with approximately 20% travel.


**Responsibilities:**



Responsible for supporting all aspects of program/project management involving planning, developing, organizing, coordinating and conducting ATO organizational activities to ensure FAA operational policies, processes and program elements are integrated and documented. This support includes any and all program management related tasks and deliverables.



Perform data driven assessments to include alternative courses of action when one or more interdependent project(s) experiences a delay, and opportunities for new technology insertions. Provide technical assistance in strategic planning, research and development, operations research, systems engineering, and briefing development support.



Additionally, tasks will include the preparation and development of various documents and briefings.



Provide support to provide decision and status review, briefing support and meeting scheduling/coordination and material preparations. Support the development and status tracking of the intermediate team schedules, and synchronization into the program integrated master schedule.



Assist in schedule development and maintenance. Provide technical input for the development of Requests for Information or Market Analysis. Provide technical input for the analysis of and screening of FAA information requests either from other FAA organizations or exterior stakeholders. Support the performance of business case analyses, including Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Exhibit\-300 documentation. Provide technical assistance in the development of strategies to achieve management development, organizational performance and change management. Assist in Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) management and provide guidance for schedule development and control.



Assist the FAA in establishing and maintaining the organization, procedures and processes to maintain and control the project schedules of the Capital Investment Plan (CIP), the objectives of the FAA Corporate Strategic Plan, and to analyze the internal and external uncertainties which affect the schedule or technical performance of a program.



Cost and Schedule Risk Assessments to include: Alternative courses of action when one or more interdependent project(s) experiences a delay, and opportunities for new technology insertions Provide technical assistance in strategic planning, research and development, operations research, systems engineering.  

Position may require firsthand support for Business Process Re\-engineering (BPR) to: Include development of As\-Is Analysis, To\-Be Analysis, and Alternatives Analysis, to make recommendations as to improving existing processes and procedures for organizations within and related to the BNATCS RSR Program.  



**Qualifications**


**Required Education \& Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree and 20 years of demonstrated experience managing a wide variety of technical and administrative projects, including experience in directing technical staff, team members and contractors.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is required.
* FAA AMS expertise is desired/a plus.
* Expertise in documentation, presentation tools, and project management tools required.
* Substitutions are:  

In lieu of a Bachelor's degree, 10 years of direct and relevant experience relating to the management/ supervision of the design, development, test or acquisition of Air Traffic Control/ Management (ATC/M) Systems. Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is required. Candidate certification must be obtained within 6 months from the date of onboarding.

 **Required Clearance:**

* US Citizenship.
* FAA Suitability: Ability to obtain and maintain FAA public trust and FAA resume approval.


Target salary range: $160,001 \- $200,000\. The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position based on experience and other factors.

You will:

* Serve as a trusted advisor to leadership on budgetary, operational, organizational, and process improvement initiatives
* Build and maintain strong working relationships with FDA leadership, program offices, and external stakeholders
* Lead and manage high\-visibility projects supporting FDA priorities, including budget, acquisition, and business transformation initiatives

* Validate work performed by team members meets weekly and bi\-weekly objectives, quality standards, and client expectations

* Support IT\-enabled initiatives and modernization efforts, translating business needs into actionable plans
* Apply business graphic design principles to produce high\-quality, visually compelling deliverables
* Mentor and oversee junior staff, reinforcing accountability, quality, and consistency in delivery
* Support workforce planning, recruitment, onboarding, and professional development efforts
* Foster a collaborative, customer\-focused environment that promotes accountability and continuous improvement


Identify opportunities to streamline operations through automation, analytics, dashboards, and business process re\-design. In addition to client delivery, you will play a key leadership role within the account by:

* Developing and mentoring junior team members, building core consulting, communication, and delivery skills
* Identifying, shaping, and capturing new business opportunities across the FDA, contributing to growth exceeding $2M annually
* Driving internal initiatives such as Project Management Office (PMO) development, culture\-building activities, Corporate Social Responsibility efforts, Lunch and Learns, and All\-Hands meetings
* Creating and maturing new capabilities that expand service offerings and strengthen account delivery
* Authoring internal policies, procedures, and processes to improve quality, consistency, and scalability
* Serving as a day\-to\-day guide for junior staff, reinforcing strong consulting practices and high\-quality client service delivery
* Collaborating closely with account Directors and Partner leadership to align on priorities, performance, and growth

 **What You Will Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification
* 5\+ years of professional experience supporting federal clients, with demonstrated success in project management and delivery execution
* Proven experience working directly with executive leadership
* Demonstrated experience developing executive\-level communications, including briefings, presentations, and decision materials
* Experience managing multiple project teams, including assigning work, tracking progress, and validating deliverables against defined timelines
* Experience managing staffing allocations across several workstreams on a weekly basis
* Strong project management background, including planning, execution, and performance tracking
* Experience supporting or delivering IT\-related projects or business system implementations
* Strong business graphic design and presentation development skills, including advanced use of PowerPoint
* Experience with Microsoft Office 365 tools (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint) to support analysis and decision\-making
* Ability to work independently with minimal oversight while maintaining alignment with leadership priorities
* Experience capturing stakeholder requirements, conducting process analysis, and developing actionable solutions
* Ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance (i.e. US citizenship is required)
* This role requires three (3\) days on\-site each week at the FDA White Oak Campus in White Oak, Maryland.

 **What Would Be Nice To Have:**

* Master’s degree
* Experience supporting executive leadership at the Food and Drug Administration
* Experience working in business transformation or centralized operating models
* Experience applying data visualization tools to communicate insights
* Familiarity with federal budget, acquisition, and financial management processes
* Lean Six Sigma certification (Green Belt or higher preferred)
* Change Management Certified Professional (CCMP) certification
* Technical background
* Proven ability to operate in a high\-tempo environment with competing priorities
* Strong attention to detail with a track record of delivering high\-quality, accurate work
* Experience developing junior team members

jobs.title: NASA SEWP Program Manager
jobs.description:
**Company Description**  

Integres, LLC is a Service\-Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) which was established to provide high quality, insightful, agile information technology\-based solutions to its customers. Integrity is a foundational element of everything we strive to do. We seek to develop solutions which respond to the evolving challenges that today’s organizations face using our own unique combination of industry best practices, and evolving techniques and technologies. We started Integres with the intent of building "a company with a soul". As such, we take a servant\-leadership approach as the long\-term strategy for our success. We are cultivating a corporate family culture which demands excellence and accountability while putting a premium on work/life balance. We empower and support our employees to contribute to achieving our corporate goals by interacting with our customers as true partners, rather than treating their engagement as just another job. We seek to be good corporate citizens and encourage and promote employee participation in community and volunteer work.

 **Job Description**  

We are seeking an experienced **NASA SEWP Program Manager** to oversee and manage contracts under the **NASA Solutions for Enterprise\-Wide Procurement (SEWP)** program. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in federal government contracting, direct experience managing NASA SEWP contracts, and the ability to ensure contract compliance, customer satisfaction, and successful program execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Manage the overall execution and administration of NASA SEWP contracts.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for NASA SEWP Program Office, customers, subcontractors, and internal stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with NASA SEWP contract requirements, federal acquisition regulations (FAR), and company policies.
* Coordinate contract deliverables, reporting, modifications, and task order management.
* Monitor contract performance, schedules, risks, and budgets to ensure successful execution.
* Support proposal development, contract transitions, and business development efforts related to NASA SEWP opportunities.
* Collaborate with technical, finance, contracts, and operations teams to ensure timely project delivery.
* Track contract metrics and prepare status reports for leadership and customers.
* Identify process improvements and implement best practices to enhance contract performance.
* Maintain strong relationships with government customers and industry partners.

  

**Qualifications**  

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of experience as a Program Manager managing Federal Government contracts.
* Minimum 1 year of direct experience managing NASA SEWP contracts.
* Strong understanding of Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR) and government contracting processes.
* Project Management Professional (PMP) certification is required or Program management degree.
* Excellent leadership, communication, organizational, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience coordinating cross\-functional teams and managing multiple priorities.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 2\+ years of hands\-on NASA SEWP contract management experience.
* Knowledge of NASA procurement policies and contract administration.
* Experience working with government customers, subcontractors, and prime contractors.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
* Prior exp as NASA SEWP PM or Deputy PM.

  

**Additional Information**  

Integres offers competitive salaries bolstered by a comprehensive benefits package, which provides safety and security for our employees and their families. Our generous benefits package includes:

* Healthcare and Insurance: medical, dental, vision, short and long\-term disability protection, basic life and AD\&D insurance
* 401(k) Savings Plan
* Accrued Paid Time Off (PTO)
* Employee Recognition and Rewards
* Employee Referral Bonuses


Integres is an equal opportunity affirmative\-action employer. We encourage Minority/Female/Protected Veteran/Disabled applicants to apply. Integres, LLC proactively fulfills its role as an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, religion, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, national origin, marital status, physical or mental disability, status as a Disabled Veteran, Recently Separated Veteran, Active Duty Wartime, or Campaign Badge Veteran, Armed Forces services Medal, or any other characteristic protected by law.


All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Zero Trust - SASE - Infrastructure Security Manager
jobs.description:
**Accenture Overview**


We are a global collective of innovators applying the New every day to improve the way the world works and lives. Help us show the world what’s possible as you partner with clients to unlock hidden value and deliver innovative solutions. Empowered with innovative tools, continuous learning, and a global community of diverse talent and perspectives, we drive success in a new business architecture that disrupts conventional practices. Our expertise spans 40\+ industries across 120\+ countries and impacts millions of lives every day. We turn ideas into reality.

**We Are**


Accenture Security helps organizations prepare, protect, detect, respond and recover along all points of the security lifecycle. Cybersecurity challenges are different for every business in every industry. Leveraging our global resources and advanced technologies, we create integrated, turnkey solutions tailored to our clients’ needs across their entire value chain. Whether we’re defending against known cyberattacks, detecting and responding to the unknown, or running an entire security operations center, we will help companies build cyber resilience to grow with confidence. Our team of the security sector’s brightest people use the coolest tech to out\-hack the hackers and help clients build resilience from within. We blend risk strategy, digital identity, cyber defense, application security and managed service solutions to rethink the entire security lifecycle.

**You Are:**

**Security and Risk** professionals develop and deliver solutions that protect enterprise systems, applications and data by establishing policies, practices and tools that prevent unauthorized access, use, disclosure, modification or disruption. A professional at this position level within Accenture has the following responsibilities:


Provides solutions to **complex business problems** for area(s) of responsibility where analysis of situations requires an in depth knowledge of organizational objectives. Involved in setting **strategic direction** to establish near term goals for area of responsibility. Interacts with senior management levels at a client and/or within Accenture, which involves negotiating or influencing on significant matters. Has **latitude** in decision\-making and determining objectives and approaches to **critical assignments**.


**The Work (Key Responsibilities):**

* Help develop, foster and sell network security projects
* Responsible for migrating client to Network Managed Service. Ensure client deliverables are produced on time according to specified project deliverables and scope
* Drive the development and upskill of junior resources
* Design and deliver network security and Secure Access Service Edge (SASE) offerings and solutions for clients as well as the following: Support the delivery of Accenture's security offerings related to cloud security, including security governance (security policies and procedures), security strategy (security planning), risk (risk assessments and management), cloud data protection (classification, encryption, tokenization), cloud\-based identity and access management, technology/provider\-specific cloud architecture (AWS, Azure, Softlayer, VMware) and monitoring/analytics for and in the cloud
* Ability to interpret relevance of security controls to relevant compliance with legal, best\-practice, and regulatory requirements for cloud environments.
* Developing and presenting at industry conferences as an expert in the Cloud Security field
* Lead the growth, development and support junior cloud security resources
* Understand engagements, business drivers and security enablement opportunities as it relates to our client's business
* Demonstrate ability to lead and manage business development / proposal efforts
* Business development responsibilities around cloud \& network security including origination, capture and relationship development
* Ability to translate technical cloud security requirements into business terms for executive stakeholders
* Conduct cloud and infrastructure security strategy, readiness and discovery assessments; be familiar with cloud security frameworks, compliance requirements and security operations
* Deliver services that meet Accenture Project quality specifications
* Ability to take initiative to communicate, interact, and collaborate with others to ensure that all aspects of a task are addressed

  

**Here’s What You Need (Basic Qualifications)**

* Minimum 5 years of experience with Prisma Access and Zscaler
* Minimum 5 years hands on experience and knowledge with network security concepts and architectures around Zero Trust and Zero Trust Network Access (ZTNA), RBI (Remote Browser Isolation) , Security Service Edge and micro\-segmentation
* Minimum of 5 years managing projects using a standardized set of project management principles
* Minimum of 5 years of technical writing and report generation
* Minimum of 5 years of managing teams of 5 or more resources
* Minimum 5 years of experience with Cloud \& Network Security vendors
* Minimum 5 years of experience Enterprise IT security risk assessments and related frameworks (e.g., ISO 27000 series, NIST 800 Series, COBIT, IT General Controls, etc.)
* Minimum 5 years of experience with multiple, simultaneous vendor management
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associate’s Degree, must have minimum 6 years work experience)
* Travel will be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 75 to 100% depending on business need and client requirements

**Bonus Points If You Have (Preferred Skills):**

* Experience in IT Security Testing (e.g., penetration testing, web application security assessments, vulnerability assessments and technical security assessments
* Experience in Identity and Access Management
* Experience in Infrastructure \& Cloud Security (virtualized environments a plus)
* Experience with application development

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon is seeking a Program Manager to join the Startup Integrated Planning team within the Global Engineering, Materials, \& Sustainability (GEMS) organization. This team owns the integrated planning function for North America's infrastructure project portfolio, connecting cross\-functional workstreams into unified, reliable schedules that guide execution across large\-scale new build and expansion/retrofit projects.  

This Program Manager will contribute to the strategic evolution of the integrated planning program, helping mature planning as a discipline. The role oversees a team of contracted project planners, setting the bar for quality and ensuring consistent delivery, while balancing program\-level strategy, cross\-functional influence, and scaling mechanisms.  

  

This is a rapidly scaling environment where processes exist but are still maturing. Success requires strategic thinking, comfort navigating ambiguity, and the judgment to refine and extend existing frameworks. A strong background in integrated scheduling is critical for providing effective program management at this scale.
  

  

This role requires up to 50% travel in the US and Canada and availability to work from a corporate office when not traveling. Candidates should either live near or be willing to relocate within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Relocation assistance may be provided.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Program Strategy \& Contracted Planner Oversight
  

* Shape and advance the workforce and vendor strategy for contracted planners, including capacity modeling, skill\-mix optimization, and procurement negotiations that scale with portfolio growth.
* Oversee contracted project planners: set expectations, provide training on planning standards, review deliverable quality, and support escalations.
* Assign and rebalance planners across projects based on priority, complexity, and workload.
* Track project budgets, manage invoicing, and provide funding inputs for planning resources.


Planning Quality, Standards, \& Governance  

* Refine and enforce quality standards for integrated project schedules, ensuring all plans connect discipline timelines, dependencies, and handovers into a single source of truth.
* Contribute to the planning maturity model and roadmap, setting progressive quality targets that evolve as the program scales.
* Design and implement governance mechanisms that validate schedule quality at scale, removing the need for manual review.
* Ensure weekly planning status reports are accurate, complete, and distributed on time to stakeholders.
* Track planning health via KPI dashboards measuring schedule integrity, milestone adherence, plan variance, and delivery date accuracy.

  

Standardization \& Continuous Improvement
  

* Develop, maintain, and enforce Standard Operating Procedures for all planning activities.
* Develop and improve planning tools, templates, and AI\-driven automations to boost planner productivity and eliminate manual workflows.
* Identify and lead initiatives that advance planning maturity, including automation, tooling, and capability building.
* Capture lessons learned from completed projects and convert them into repeatable, scalable best practices.

  

Risk Management \& Reporting
  

* Identify and mitigate program\-level planning risks; own escalation paths and drive issues to resolution.
* Ensure planners identify cross\-functional dependencies and surface risks early, before they become execution problems.
* Develop and refine risk and reporting frameworks that give leadership the signal needed to make portfolio\-level decisions
* Provide clear, data\-driven status reporting to senior leadership on portfolio\-wide planning performance.

  

Program\-Level Cross\-Functional Partnership
  

* Build and maintain program\-level relationships with key partner functions (design, operations, construction, launch, IT, engineering) to drive planning adoption and standardization.
* Serve as the planning liaison with partner functions, championing integrated scheduling practices and ensuring planning inputs are prioritized.
* Drive continuous improvement of integrated planning by gathering feedback from partner functions and refining how planning intersects with their workflows.
* Represent the Integrated Planning program in global and cross\-functional forums, aligning planning standards and resolving systemic gaps across disciplines.

* 3\+ years of program or project management experience
* 3\+ years of defining and implementing process improvement initiatives using data and metrics experience
* Knowledge of Excel (Pivot Tables, VLookUps) at an advanced level and SQL
* Experience using data and metrics to determine and drive improvements
* Experience working cross functionally with tech and non\-tech teams
* Experience handling ambiguous or undefined challenges through strong problem solving abilities

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* 3\+ years of driving end to end delivery, and communicating results to senior leadership experience
* 3\+ years of driving process improvements experience
* Experience in stakeholder management, dealing with multiple stakeholders at varied levels of the organization
* Experience building processes, project management, and schedules

* Experience in construction or project management
* Knowledge of data visualization tools such as Quick Sight, Tableau, Power BI or other BI packages
* Experience developing solutions and executing plans on complex projects
* Experience with vendor and contractor/subcontractor negotiation and management skills associated with construction and project execution

jobs.description:
**About Agile Defense**

At Agile Defense we know that action defines the outcome and new challenges require new solutions. That’s why we always look to the future and embrace change with an unmovable spirit and the courage to build for what comes next.

Our vision is to bring adaptive innovation to support our nation's most important missions through the seamless integration of advanced technologies, elite minds, and unparalleled agility—leveraging a foundation of speed, flexibility, and ingenuity to strengthen and protect our nation’s vital interests.  

Title: Program Managers, Deputy Program Managers, Senior Project Managers \& Project Managers (CBP)
Clearance: Active CBP Background Investigation (CBP BI) and EOD strongly preferred. We can begin processing for candidates who do not hold one.
Citizenship: U.S. Citizenship required Location: \[required] \\u007C \[on\-site / hybrid posture required]
Salary Range: \[required]
Signing Bonus: $10,000 for candidates with an active CBP BI. Payable after 90 days; standard terms apply.
Travel: occassional as needed
### **The Work**


U.S. Customs and Border Protection runs continuous operations across more than 300 land, air, and sea ports of entry, plus Border Patrol stations and the Air and Marine Operations Center. Delivering technical work into that environment is a different problem from delivering it into an office. You cannot take a checkpoint down on a Tuesday because the schedule says so. Change windows are narrow, some sites are hours from the nearest support, and a slipped date can mean an officer working without a tool they were told to expect.

We are hiring project and program managers to run delivery across that constraint. You will coordinate work spanning network, cloud, cybersecurity, and field deployment teams, manage commitments with the customer, and move work through federal change control and accreditation processes that set the pace whether or not your plan accounted for them.

One thing is worth knowing before you apply. This is not a role where the schedule is the job. The engineers here can build; what slows delivery is dependency, approval, access, and the gap between what a plan assumed about a site and what is true at that site. Managers who treat those as somebody else's problem do not do well here.
### **What Success Looks Like**


Objective 1: Turn commitments into schedules that survive contact with a 24/7 environment
* Plans account for the change windows and site access constraints that actually govern the work, not the ones that are convenient to plan around.
* Dependencies between network, cloud, security, and field teams surface before they become a delay.
* Estimates come from the people doing the work, and get challenged rather than either accepted whole or overwritten.
* When a date moves, the customer hears it from you, with a reason and an option.


Objective 2: Give the customer a picture of the program that matches what is happening
* Status reporting tells the customer something they can act on rather than a color that covers a problem.
* Risks appear on the register while there is still time to do something about them.
* The customer stops arranging side conversations to find out how the work is really going.
* What you report measures delivery rather than activity.


Objective 3: Remove the obstacles that keep engineers from delivering
* Blockers get resolved at the lowest level that can resolve them, and escalate quickly when they cannot.
* Engineers spend their time on the work instead of chasing approvals, access, and equipment.
* Recurring administrative friction gets fixed at its source rather than absorbed again every month.

### **Where You'd Fit**


We are hiring across several levels, and one of these roles is scoped by portfolio rather than by seniority. You do not need to pick one before applying. Tell us where you think you land and we will talk about it.
* Project Manager. You own a project's scope, schedule, and delivery. You make routine sequencing and resourcing calls yourself and bring the ones with customer impact to a review.
* Cloud Project Manager. You own delivery of the cloud workstream, including its dependencies on security and accreditation. You decide sequencing across builds, migrations, and authorization milestones.
* Senior Project Manager. You take the projects that arrive without a clear path, including the ones already in trouble when you get them. Other project managers check their approach with you before committing to a date.
* Deputy Program Manager. You own a defined slice of the program full time and step into the Program Manager's authority when they are unavailable. Escalations that would otherwise reach the Program Manager come to you first, and most stop there.
* Program Manager. You own whether the program delivers as a whole, including commitments you inherited and work you do not directly manage. You are the customer's counterpart when something goes wrong.

### **What You Bring**


Minimum Qualifications
\[Verbatim from the labor category, per level. These differ across Project Manager through Program Manager, including Deputy Program Manager. Note: a prior Agile Defense Deputy Program Manager performance profile exists and should be used as the baseline for that rung's qualifications and objectives once available, rather than drafted fresh. State the band honestly rather than publishing the highest bar. Required before publishing.]
Preferred Experience
* You have delivered technical work in a federal program where change control and accreditation set the pace.
* You have told a customer bad news early, and can describe how that conversation went and what it cost you.
* You have run delivery across teams you did not manage and had no authority over.
* You have taken over a project that was already behind and can say what you changed first.

**Job Description**  

BAE Systems is the premier provider of Full Motion Video (FMV) exploitation. We are currently seeking multiple high performing analysts to support an operational cell with video forensics and in\-depth research analysis.  

  

\*\*This position is NOT on a 24x7 rotation schedule. However, on this program, employees must be able and willing to work added and/or "abnormal" work hours to meet the needs of the client/customer.
  

  

Analysts must be able to work in a fusion cell, specifically integrating GEOINT, IMINT, FMV, among other INTs, into intelligence products. Candidates must have the ability to exploit video footage collected by sensors on Intelligence, Surveillance, and Reconnaissance (ISR) platforms as well as in\-depth, advanced research culminating in comprehensive, fused, multi\-INT intelligence products. **Candidates must have an active clearance with polygraph to be considered and be willing and capable of passing** ***additional*** **polygraphs by the Government.**  

  

**Required Education, Experience, \& Skills**  

* 5 years of combined Intelligence experience, which can be supplemented by a relevant degree (AA \= 2 years, BA \= 3 years)
* 5 years of full\-time and/or active duty motion geospatial or full motion video (FMV) analysis mission experience \- We cannot substitute other Intelligence disciplines of Intelligence for the 3 minimum years required for this role
* Must possess TS/SCI clearance and be capable of obtaining and maintaining full polygraph accesses. A current CI polygraph is preferred but not required for this role.
* Work a standard 40 hr work week and be willing and able to work nights, weekends and holidays if and when necessary.
* During high\-tempo operations, can maintain situational awareness and can verbally and in writing relay and articulate intelligence.
* Can prioritize and solve routine tasks, positively impact customer and team relations.
* Excellent working knowledge of MS Office Suite: MS Word \& MS PowerPoint.
* Excellent analytical writing skills.
* Must be an advanced keyboarder at 32 WPM with 100% accuracy or better without looking at a keyboard.
* Candidates must possess the ability to accurately discern red, green, blue, and yellow colors on a screen.
* Must attain FMV analyst qualifications and maintain required minimum skill level in each position.
* Must already possess GPC\-F certification.

  

**Preferred Education, Experience, \& Skills**  

* Over 5\-9 years of (FMV) analysis mission experience
* BA/BS in field relevant to geospatial intelligence, intelligence studies, etc.
* Experience in coding, python scripting, and/or using ArcGIS (ESRI) programs
* Experience using Adobe Premiere Pro
* Experience using Microsoft Access
* Possess GPC IA or GA Level II certification

  

**Pay Information**  

Full\-Time Salary Range: $92290 \- $156860  

  

Please note: This range is based on our market pay structures. However, individual salaries are determined by a variety of factors including, but not limited to: business considerations, local market conditions, and internal equity, as well as candidate qualifications, such as skills, education, and experience.

Regular employees scheduled to work 20\+ hours per week are offered: health, dental, and vision insurance; health savings accounts; a 401(k) savings plan; disability coverage; and life and accident insurance. We also have an employee assistance program, a legal plan, and other perks including discounts on things like home, auto, and pet insurance. Our leave programs include paid time off, paid holidays, as well as other types of leave, including paid parental, military, bereavement, and any applicable federal and state sick leave. Employees may participate in the company recognition program to receive monetary or non\-monetary recognition awards. Other incentives may be available based on position level and/or job specifics.  

  

**About BAE Systems Intelligence \& Security**  

BAE Systems, Inc. is the U.S. subsidiary of BAE Systems plc, an international defense, aerospace and security company which delivers a full range of products and services for air, land and naval forces, as well as advanced electronics, security, information technology solutions and customer support services. Improving the future and protecting lives is an ambitious mission, but it’s what we do at BAE Systems. Working here means using your passion and ingenuity where it counts – defending national security with breakthrough technology, superior products, and intelligence solutions. As you develop the latest technology and defend national security, you will continually hone your skills on a team—making a big impact on a global scale. At BAE Systems, you’ll find a rewarding career that truly makes a difference.  

  

Intelligence \& Security (I\&S), based in McLean, Virginia, designs and delivers advanced defense, intelligence, and security solutions that support the important missions of our customers. Our pride and dedication shows in everything we do—from intelligence analysis, cyber operations and IT expertise to systems development, systems integration, and operations and maintenance services. Knowing that our work enables the U.S. military and government to recognize, manage and defeat threats inspires us to push ourselves and our technologies to new levels.

jobs.description:
SkyePoint Decisions is a leading Cybersecurity Architecture and Engineering, Critical Infrastructure and Operations, and Applications Development and Maintenance IT service provider headquartered in Dulles, Virginia with operations across the U.S. We provide innovative enterprise\-wide solutions as well as targeted services addressing the complex challenges faced by our federal government clients. Our focus is on enabling our clients to deliver their mission most efficiently and effectively – anytime, anywhere, securely. We combine technical expertise, mission awareness, and an empowered workforce to produce meaningful results.

**This is a contingent position based on contract win.**



SkyePoint Decisions is seeking a Research Application Services (RAS) Continuity and Resilience Project Manager to be responsible for leading and coordinating cybersecurity, continuity, contingency planning, and operational resilience activities supporting NIH Research Application Services (RAS) environments. This role serves as the primary liaison between program leadership, cybersecurity teams, system owners, researchers, technical staff, and Government stakeholders to ensure critical research systems remain secure, compliant, operational, and resilient during cyber incidents, system outages, and other disruptive events.



The position oversees project planning, continuity and contingency planning activities, business impact analyses (BIAs), stakeholder coordination, risk management, recovery planning, and compliance initiatives. Working closely with RMF, Governance, Risk \& Compliance (GRC), Vulnerability Management, Incident Response, Infrastructure, and Technical Operations teams, the Project Manager ensures NIH research applications meet Federal cybersecurity requirements while maintaining operational continuity and recovery readiness.



This position is a fully remote position.
**Responsibilities:**


**Program \& Project Management**


* Manage day\-to\-day coordination of cybersecurity, continuity, and operational resilience activities supporting NIH Research Application Services (RAS).
* Develop and maintain Integrated Master Schedules (IMS), project schedules, milestones, deliverables, dependencies, and resource plans.
* Coordinate activities across cybersecurity, infrastructure, application, business, and research stakeholder teams.
* Facilitate status meetings, stakeholder briefings, governance reviews, and action\-item tracking.
* Monitor project performance and ensure activities remain aligned with NIH objectives and program priorities.
* Maintain action, risk, issue, and dependency register and track risks, issues, decisions, dependencies, and corrective actions through resolution.
* Ensure cybersecurity, continuity, and resilience activities are integrated into overall program management processes.
* Support cybersecurity stakeholder inquiries and operational coordination activities.
* Support knowledge management repositories, templates, SOPs, playbooks, and training materials.
* Support monthly reporting and KPI dashboard development


**Research Application Services (RAS) Program Support**


* Serve as the primary coordinator supporting NIH Researcher Auth Service (RAS) initiatives and BioData Catalyst operational cybersecurity activities.
* Coordinate with NIH Center for Information Technology (CIT), BioData Catalyst teams, system owners, cybersecurity personnel, and NHLBI stakeholders.
* Support NIH Controlled Access Data Repository (CADR) compliance activities.
* Track RAS\-related risks, dependencies, milestones, corrective actions, and compliance requirements.
* Coordinate authorization package updates, continuous monitoring activities, documentation reviews, and audit\-readiness efforts associated with RAS\-supported systems.
* Support evolving NIH RAS requirements and integration activities as NIH enterprise RAS capabilities mature.
* Develop executive reports, status updates, and governance materials supporting RAS initiatives.


**Continuity \& Contingency Planning**


* Develop, maintain, and update Continuity of Operations Plans (COOPs), Information System Contingency Plans (ISCPs), Disaster Recovery Plans (DRPs), and related recovery documentation.
* Support operational resilience initiatives across NIH research systems, applications, and supporting infrastructure.
* Identify critical business functions, mission dependencies, and recovery priorities.
* Ensure continuity and recovery requirements are incorporated into cybersecurity and operational planning activities.
* Coordinate continuity planning efforts among technical teams, system owners, and business stakeholders.
* Assess potential operational impacts associated with system disruptions, cyber incidents, and service outages.
* Support cybersecurity planning activities associated with system retirement and decommissioning efforts.
* Coordinate decommissioning plans, stakeholder communications, dependency analysis, inventory updates, and closure documentation.
* Support secure disposition activities consistent with NIST SP 800\-88 guidance.
* Coordinate continuity impacts associated with system retirement efforts


**Business Impact Analysis \& Recovery Planning**


* Conduct and maintain Business Impact Analyses (BIAs) to identify critical processes, dependencies, and recovery requirements.
* Define and document Recovery Time Objectives (RTOs) and Recovery Point Objectives (RPOs).
* Maintain BIA documentation, recovery analyses, and continuity planning artifacts.
* Develop recommendations to strengthen resilience, recovery readiness, and mission continuity capabilities.
* Ensure continuity planning documentation aligns with NIH, HHS, and Federal requirements.


**Cybersecurity \& Compliance Support**


* Coordinate with RMF, Assessment \& Authorization (A\&A), GRC, Vulnerability Management, Threat Detection, Incident Response, and Technical Operations teams.
* Support NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF) activities

At Capital One, we are relentless innovators with a proven track record of transforming customers’ experiences and the financial services industry. We’re delivering best\-in\-class innovation so that our more than 100 million customers can manage their finances with ease.


We consider ourselves the bank a technology company would build – empowered to use artificial intelligence (from machine learning to generative AI) to transform everyday banking into real\-time, intelligent products that help customers improve their financial well\-being. We’re all\-in on the cloud and are a leader in the adoption of open source. We build our own products and release them with a speed and agility that allows us to get new customer experiences to market quickly. We’re going boldly where no bank has gone before. And, as a founder\-led company, we are centered in our mission to help customers succeed.

**The Role \| General Responsibilities:**


We’re seeking a Senior Associate, Product Strategy, to support strategic priorities for the Consumer and Developer Experience (CDX) leadership team. CDX is an exciting space with diverse product responsibilities. The organization’s remit spans customer digital engagement, including the Capital One app; Capital One’s marketing platform, analytics, and personalization engine; the product suite used to manage all Capital One suppliers and vendors; products associated with the company’s risk management responsibilities; and more.


The Senior Associate will join a horizontal product and strategy team that supports priorities across CDX. We operate with the rigor of top\-tier consulting to solve the organization’s hardest strategic questions, drive the annual planning process, and align our long\-term priorities. At the same time, we are builders: we act as an innovation lab, developing prototypes and partnering closely with product and engineering teams to translate conceptual visions into tangible, scaled digital experiences. We are looking for someone who thrives in this duality – someone who is equally energized by big\-picture questions about where the world is going, thorny problems that require a strategic mindset and close partnership with product and tech teams, and hands\-on building.

jobs.description:
**Summary**
-----------


The National Counterterrorism Center (NCTC) leads the nation's effort to protect the United States from terrorism by integrating, analyzing and sharing information to drive whole\-of\-government action and achieve our national CT objectives.


Learn more about this agency


  
**This job is open to**
-----------------------


### **The public**


U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.
### **Clarification from the agency**


Open to current and former Federal employees with competitive or excepted status; and all U.S. Citizens. Former members of the Peace Corps may be considered for ODNI employment only if five full years have elapsed since separation from the Peace Corps.


  
**Duties**
----------


This position is within the Directorate of Identity Intelligence. The selected candidate will be responsible for supporting Identity Intelligence efforts focused on known or suspected terrorist biometric and biographic information. Selected candidates will work with data from across the Intelligence Community, Federal Bureau of Investigation, and other sources. Selected candidates will be responsible for ensuring that policies and procedures are applied consistently and accurately to the Terrorist Identities Datamart Environment (TIDE) database, and ensuring the integrity of the data used to populate TIDE with international terrorist identities information. The person in this position is expected to exhibit professional and inclusive behaviors and help create and maintain a positive, professional, and high\-performance workplace.  

  

Develop an understanding of and utilize a variety of methodological tools and approaches to gain a comprehensive understanding of known or suspected terrorists (KSTs), including as appropriate, social networking and other "new" media; incorporate policies, strategies, tactics, techniques, procedures and mechanisms to reveal the true identity of individuals, personas, or groups by analyzing and exploiting data related to sets of specific identity attributes to build the most comprehensive terrorist identity record available to the USG.  

  

Resolve identities through the integration of biographic, biometric, contextual and behavioral information.  

  

Plan, develop, utilize, and refine methodological tools and approaches to gain a comprehensive understanding of complex and significant issues and incorporate insights and findings into reports.  

  

Identify, gather, and extract Identity Intelligence information as required to determine relationships, patterns, trends, indicators and warnings that address intelligence gaps.  

  

Plan, identify, and develop strategies to overcome identified gaps and increase efficiencies in data collection or processes. Cultivate and facilitate collaborate with counterparts in other agencies to support the integration of IC\-wide terrorism analysis capabilities throughout the USG.  

  

Perform in\-depth research and analysis; conduct targeted analysis of terrorist personalities, groups and networks for future analytical and watchlisting purposes. Present findings as appropriate via written products, graphic presentations or oral briefings.  

  

Manage, initiate, cultivate, and maintain cooperative and productive relationships with individuals in the US Government (USG), Intelligence Community (IC), and ODNI.  

  

Assist in setting priorities and driving programs to ensure senior Office of the Director of National Intelligence (ODNI) officials are prepared for policy meetings throughout the Intelligence Community (IC) and US Government (USG).


  
**Requirements**
----------------


### **Conditions of employment**


* Must be a U.S. Citizen residing in the United States
* Appointment is subject to a suitability or fitness determination, as determined by a completed background investigation.
* Must be able to obtain and maintain a Top Secret security clearance based on an SBI with eligibility for sensitive compartmented information (SCI)
* Male applicants born after December 31, 1959, must complete a Pre\-Employment Certification Statement for Selective Service Registration.
* A two\-year trial period is required for all new permanent appointments to the ODNI.

### **Qualifications**


**FREE RESPONSE ESSAY QUESTIONS**

jobs.title: Senior Operations Analyst
jobs.description:
Hydrosat is a space and data analytics company building a new Earth observation constellation and software platform to unlock the power of thermal infrared imagery. We deliver high\-resolution thermal insights that help governments, defense agencies, and agribusinesses better manage water resources, agricultural production, national security threats, and critical infrastructure.


We grow through two distinct routes to market – government programmes, and commercial data and subscription products – and our Operations team keeps the business running behind both, giving executive leadership a clear, trusted view of how the company is performing.


We are looking for an **Operations Analyst** to join our Operations team and work closely with our Chief of Corporate Operations. You will help plan, coordinate, and build financial and operational models. You will also help support analysis and strategy proposals that inform how Hydrosat runs its business – from employee compensation and departmental planning, to ESG, ERM, and other org\-wide efforts. You will support organization of the efficiency metrics that tell leadership where the company stands, as well as the implementation processes that result. Using Excel, PowerPoint, AI, and other tools of the trade you will turn complex, cross\-functional data and workflows into clear analysis and presentation decks that senior leadership and department heads can act on, and will help with coordination and implementation across departments for such programs.


This is not a narrow reporting role. We expect our Senior Operations Analyst to be a genuine thought partner to the CCO and executive leadership – helping structure how the company thinks about its own performance, not just producing the numbers. The ideal candidate is as comfortable, for example, building a compensation model from scratch as they are distilling it into a clear, well\-organized narrative for a monthly business review.

**Responsibilities may include but are not limited to**

* Act as a flexible operations resource to the CCO, picking up cross\-functional analysis, coordination, and projects as priorities shift
* Build clear, well\-structured Excel models and PowerPoint presentations that make complex operational and financial topics easy for leadership to act on
* Prepare and help coordinate and run monthly revenue reviews, business reviews, and other leadership initiatives with the CCO, department leads and executive leadership
* Partner closely with the CCO and executive leadership on corporate operations, business planning, and company financial topics
* Build and maintain models and plans which may range from ERM, to ESG, OKRs, KPIs, supporting benchmarking, budgeting, and compensation planning decisions, among other key areas of org infrastructure
* Help define and track efficiency metrics across departments, giving leadership a consistent way to measure how the business is performing
* Support departmental modelling and planning, working with department leads to support the build\-out and refinement oftheir operating plans
* Develop financial and compensation models that hold up to scrutiny from leadership, the board, and investors
* Strong facility with Excel modelling and building polished, executive\-ready PowerPoint presentations
* Experience in corporate operations, business operations, or corporate finance, ideally including exposure to complex company structural and/or financing topics
* A structured, organized way of thinking – you don't need to be the one presenting, but your analysis needs to tell a clear story
* Comfortable working closely to support a CCO (and where needed other executive leadership directly), with thecoordination skills, judgment and discretion that requires
* Ability to naturally multitask and work across a broad array of professional topics, considerations, time\-zones, and other diverse daily work requirements
* Excellent written and analytical communication skills
* Eligible to work in the United States

**Ideal Profile**

* Exposure to both large company and a small company priorities and underlying realities – for example, starting a career at a larger organization before moving to a startup and helping build something from scratch (or vice\-versa)
* A “spirit of organization and presentation”: someone who naturally organizes their thinking into a clear structure, even if presenting it to a room isn't the main part of the role, though there will be future opportunities for this as well
* Comfortable working remotely as part of a distributed team; candidates based on the US East Coast are preferred

**Nice to Have**

* Background in a startup or scale\-up environment, having helped build an operations or similar function from the ground up
* Experience supporting a C\-level executive or executive leadership team directly
* Exposure to the space, geospatial, Earth observation, or another deep\-tech industry
* Hands\-on experience building departmental planning, efficiency, or compensation models

 **Current Benefits**

* Competitive compensation package
* Stock options to share in Hydrosat’s long\-term success
* Fast\-moving, mission\-driven startup environment with real ownership
* Remote\-friendly role with flexibility
* Basic medical, dental, and vision insurance – 100% employer\-paid for you, 50% for dependents
* Employer\-paid base life insurance, plus optional accident, hospital, and critical illness coverage
* 401(k) with a Safe Harbor match – 100% of your contributions up to 4% of pay, vested from day one
* Unlimited PTO, 16 firm holidays, and 6 sick/safe days each year
* 100% paid parental leave – 12 weeks for birth parents, 8 weeks for the other parent, adoption, or surrogacy
* FSA/HSA options, commuter benefits, and a monthly cell phone stipend
* Employee Assistance Program and mental health support through Spring Health

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

  

  

Make a direct impact at the heart of the investment lifecycle. Join JPMorganChase's International Private Bank in Geneva, where you will support end\-to\-end transaction processing while helping drive new initiatives that strengthen risk and control. You will be part of an inclusive, collaborative team that values your ideas and supports your professional growth.


As an Investment Operations Analyst within our operations team, you will help ensure the seamless execution, settlement, and administration of a broad range of investment products. With multiple openings across the Investment Operations organization, you may align to teams supporting areas such as Alternatives, Mutual Funds, Equities, Fixed Income, foreign exchange (FX), Derivatives, and Regulatory Reporting. You will partner closely with investment teams, client service, operations colleagues, and technology partners to deliver outcomes for clients and continuously improve how we work.

* Provide operational support across the trade and investment lifecycle, including confirmations, settlement, cash processing, asset transfers, corporate actions, reconciliations, and reporting
* Monitor daily workflows and follow up on exceptions to ensure timely and accurate completion of activities
* Investigate breaks and escalate issues appropriately to support timely resolution and minimize client impact
* Drive process improvement initiatives, including standardization, control enhancements, and operational risk reduction
* Respond to inquiries from internal and external stakeholders, including technology, finance, custodians, brokers, and fund administrators
* Support audits, compliance reviews, and regulatory or internal reporting requirements with strong documentation and governance practices
* Partner with business and technology teams to gather requirements, support testing, and assist with implementations for process and control enhancements
* Learn and adopt approved artificial intelligence tools and new technologies to improve efficiency, accuracy, and service outcomes while maintaining strong controls and data discipline

**Required qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Strong written and verbal communication skills with working proficiency in English
* Proficiency in Excel and comfort working with data (for example, organizing, validating, reconciling, and reporting)
* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy and quality
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and deadlines
* Ability to prioritize effectively and take initiative in a fast\-paced environment
* Ability to collaborate effectively as part of a team across global partners

**Preferred qualifications, capabilities, and skills**

* Experience in IT Security Testing (e.g., penetration testing, web application security assessments, vulnerability assessments and technical security assessments
* Experience in Identity and Access Management

jobs.title: Associate Project Manager (Facility Asset Management)
jobs.description:
The Associate Project Manager position ensures that all assigned projects are properly scoped, designed, and executed with an emphasis on strict scope, budget, and schedule control. You will successfully manage each assigned project from inception to completion, continually delivering projects within the approved budget and schedule with the highest quality, cost\-effectiveness, and efficiency.


You will report to the Manager of Programs

**Responsibilities**
--------------------


SAFETY:

* Responsible for overall project safety, obtaining final approval for contractor submitted safety plans and compliance to the project safety plan. Includes compliance to all regulatory (OSHA) requirements, corporate governance requirements, and Facilities Asset Management (FAM) Standard Operating Guide (SOG).


PLANNING \& DEVELOPMENT:

* Responsible for the development, planning, execution, and closeout of all aspects of the project throughout the project life. Includes project design, development, implementation, budget, cash flow reporting, and maintaining accurate Estimated Forecast to Complete (EFC) for financial reporting, and maintenance of all job files.
* Lead project scope development and options analysis. Lead project estimate development and review with the support of the Project Estimator. Develop project implementation strategy and schedule with the support of Project Scheduler. Obtain funding approval before implementation with the support of the Project Controller.
* Closely manage project timelines and schedules to manage client expectations and ensure minimum impact on Operations.


TEAMWORK AND COLLABORATION:

* Assemble project teams with internal and external resources to complete all assigned projects.
* Oversee the efforts of all project team members to ensure that they are working as an integrated team in delivering against project goals.
* Develop and maintain positive relationships with team members and customers/clients.
* Partner with all lines of business (LOB) to ensure the final product best meets the intended business objective.


CONTRACT DEVELOPMENT:

* Provide support for the administration of contracts including the scope of work, unit costing items, bid alternates, and operational constraints required for contract preparation.


PROJECT SCHEDULE:

* Responsible for the project schedule, establishing critical path tasks to ensure schedule compliance, and ensuring proper man loading requirements of the contractor to achieve the desired completion date.


CLIENT COMMUNICATION:

* Responsible for coordinating operational constraints and job objectives together to achieve a seamless project. Including timely communication with Business Partners, Clients, and management regarding project status, schedule, and financial and guest impacts.
* Communicate project information effectively to LOB client and all impacted Resort divisions and management.


TECHNICAL COMPETENCY:

* Technically competent with various software programs such as construction management software and Microsoft suite of products (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, etc.) Utilize project and contract management systems in the daily operation of the business.


PROCESS COMPETENCY:

* Responsible for timely issuance of field directives, collection of costing concurrence memos, conversion to change orders, and management approval to allow for accurate Estimated Forecast to Complete (EFC) reporting and timely job closeout.
* Manage project budgets and provide timely project spending updates with the support of the Project Controller.
* Work closely with the Program Manager to accomplish objectives and improve business processes. Focus on continuous performance improvement and efficiency.

**Basic Qualifications**
------------------------

* Four\-year college degree (BA / BS) in project/construction management or related field and 2\+ years of applicable hands\-on project/ construction experience or 2 years of college and 8\+ years of applicable hands\-on project/construction experience.
* Four years of project management/construction management in hospitality, commercial and industrial construction. Theme Park construction experience is a plus.
* Proven knowledge of project management process and demonstrated ability to manage a portfolio of projects over $4M annually.
* Proven knowledge of project accounting, estimating, scheduling, budgeting, document management, best value contracting, contract management, and cost forecasting.
* Knowledge of construction materials, methods, and techniques. Familiarity with all construction applicable codes, i.e., UBC, NEC \& UFC.
* Excellent oral and written communication skills with the ability to prepare presentations for department management reviews that drive related decisions.
* Outstanding attention to detail and organization skills.
* Demonstrated leadership skills.
* Demonstrated computer skills in Windows, Excel, and PowerPoint.
* Ability to communicate with all levels, including hourly crafts as well as executives.
* Ability to prepare and deliver executive presentations.
* Strong customer service orientation.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to identify project\-related risks and propose mitigation plans.

**Required Education**
----------------------

* Four\-year college degree (BA/BS) in project/construction management or related field and 2\+ years of project/ construction related experience; or 2 years of college and 8\+ years of applicable hands\-on project/construction experience.

**Preferred Education**
-----------------------

* MBA in Project/Construction Management or related field
* Knowledge of Primavera P6, MS Access, and/or PMWeb.

jobs.title: Risk Program Manager
jobs.description:
About Us:
**Company Overview**
Foundation Building Materials (FBM) is a leading construction materials distribution company serving the commercial and residential construction markets across United States and Canada. In conjunction with Unified Door \& Hardware Group (UDHG), a premier provider of commercial door, frame, and hardware solutions, FBM supports a broad range of construction and architectural projects nationwide.  

Together, FBM and UDHG’s 8,000\+ Team Members are committed to operational excellence, innovation, and employee development. By combining scale, specialty expertise, and a customer\-first mindset, we deliver high\-quality products and services to contractors, builders, and project teams across diverse markets. As the organization continues to grow and evolve following the recent acquisition by Lowe’s, we are investing in strong, forward\-thinking talent to support our long\-term success.
Overview:
**Position Overview**
The **Risk Program Manager** develops, implements, and continuously improves enterprise risk programs that strengthen field awareness, standardize risk practices, and support the organization’s insurance and loss\-prevention objectives. Serving as a strategic partner to operational leadership, this role uses risk data, insurance insights, and field engagement to identify emerging exposures, improve risk controls, and influence practical mitigation strategies across a large, geographically distributed branch network. The Risk Program Manager serves as the functional owner of key risk systems and resources, including Origami, incident reporting workflows, dashboards, risk communications, and field\-facing training.  

The Risk Program Manager also owns the company’s certificate of insurance (COI) management program, leads the COI Administrator, supports claims and insurance program analytics, and contributes to annual renewal and underwriting activities. Working in close partnership with Safety, Operations, Legal, Finance, Procurement, insurance brokers, carriers, and other partners, the role translates incident trends, claims information, insurance requirements, and operational needs into scalable programs and actionable recommendations. This is an opportunity to help shape and strengthen FBM’s risk\-management capabilities during a period of significant organizational growth and transformation.
Responsibilities and Qualifications:
**Key Responsibilities****Risk Program Development \& Management*** Build, enhance, and govern enterprise risk programs, including incident reporting, claims workflows, loss\-prevention initiatives, and field mitigation programs.
* Serve as the functional owner and administrator of Origami, including configuration, workflows, notifications, dashboards, reporting, data quality, user adoption, and continuous platform improvement.
* Develop and maintain centralized risk resources, standards, templates, guides, and field\-facing materials that support consistent execution across branches and business units.
* Establish program governance, decision criteria, and escalation practices that improve accountability, responsiveness, and consistency across risk\-management processes.
* Publish recurring risk communications, including a risk newsletter, to drive awareness, education, and engagement.


**COI \& Third\-Party Risk Program Oversight*** Own the full certificate of insurance (COI) management program, lead the COI Administrator, and oversee the end\-to\-end COI lifecycle.
* Establish and maintain standards for COI intake, verification, retention, exceptions, escalation, and documentation.
* Monitor COI compliance, turnaround time, recurring deficiencies, and other program metrics; recommend process or control improvements based on trends and business needs.
* Partner with Legal, Procurement, Operations, and other stakeholders to support vendor compliance and consistent application of insurance requirements.
* Develop and deliver training on COI requirements, vendor compliance, and documentation standards.


**Insurance \& Claims Program Support*** Support annual insurance renewals, exposure data collection, underwriting submissions, broker coordination, and responses to carrier or underwriter information requests.
* Analyze exposure, loss, and claims information to identify trends, data\-quality issues, and opportunities to improve insurance program performance and risk mitigation.
* Support claims reporting processes and periodic claims reviews with internal stakeholders, brokers, carriers, and third\-party administrators, as applicable.
* Develop field\-facing guidance explaining coverage, deductibles, reporting requirements, claim\-reporting expectations, and risk\-management best practices.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders and insurance partners to support timely, accurate information exchange and effective program administration.


**Field Risk Awareness, Training \& Operational Partnership*** Create and deliver risk\-awareness training modules, tools, and communications for field leaders and branch teams.
* Build strong relationships with field and functional leaders and influence adoption of risk\-management practices without relying on formal authority.
* Identify emerging risk trends and partner with Operations and Safety to develop targeted mitigation strategies, corrective actions, and practical field solutions.
* Serve as a primary liaison between Risk Management and Operations to ensure clarity, consistency, responsiveness, and effective issue resolution.
* Use risk resources, training, and recurring communications to reinforce field awareness and consistent risk practices across the organization.


**Risk Analytics \& Continuous Improvement*** Define and maintain key risk indicators, program metrics, scorecards, and dashboards, including measures related to incident frequency and severity, reporting timeliness, COI compliance, claims trends, training adoption, and process effectiveness where data is availa

jobs.description:

CLEARANCE REQUIRED FOR START: Yes
CLEARANCE TYPE: Top Secret
TRAVEL: Yes, 25% of the Time**Description**
---------------


At Northrop Grumman, our employees have incredible opportunities to work on revolutionary systems that impact people's lives around the world today, and for generations to come. Our pioneering and inventive spirit has enabled us to be at the forefront of many technological advancements in our nation's history \- from the first flight across the Atlantic Ocean, to stealth bombers, to landing on the moon. We look for people who have bold new ideas, courage and a pioneering spirit to join forces to invent the future, and have fun along the way. Our culture thrives on intellectual curiosity, cognitive diversity and bringing your whole self to work — and we have an insatiable drive to do what others think is impossible. Our employees are not only part of history, they're making history.
Northrop Grumman (NG) is seeking an **Industrial Security Manager 3** to lead and manage the sector\-wide investigations, insider threat, and counterintelligence program for the Aeronautics Systems Sector. As a key member of the centralized NG Investigations, Insider Threat, and Counterintelligence Team, this role has primary responsibility for that sector while also enabling and supporting aligned investigative and insider threat efforts across the company. The role reports directly to the Corporate Director of Investigations and Insider Threat and serves as a principal advisor to the Aeronautics Sector Senior Security Director, as well as other sector and company leadership. This position is located in **M****elbourne, FL OR Palmdale, CA,** and due to the dynamic environment and size of both the sector and the company, domestic and international travel is required.

**Primary Responsibilities:**


Sector \& Enterprise Leadership

* Provide sector\-wide leadership for investigations, insider threat, and counterintelligence activities, set priorities and ensure effective allocation of investigative and analytic resources.
* Serve as an enterprise leader and thought partner by helping to shape and implement policies, procedures, workflows, initiatives, and cross\-sector teaming efforts.
* Develop and maintain procedures, operating standards, and investigative protocols.
* Track program performance using key metrics and preparing reports, dashboards, and executive summaries.
* Recommend improvements which enhance operational effectiveness, regulatory compliance, and customer service.
* Maintain well\-established liaison relationships in the investigations, insider threat, and counterintelligence arenas with law enforcement, prosecutorial agencies, and the intelligence community, such as DCSA, FBI, AFOSI, and NCIS.


Enterprise Investigations

* Manage the corporate investigations program for the sector, including allegations of insider threat activity, counterintelligence concerns, workplace violence, fraud, misconduct, theft, policy violations, and other security\-related incidents.
* Lead and oversee investigators and case work to ensure fair, objective, legally defensible investigations and compliance with government, customer, and corporate policies, procedures, and practices.
* Conduct and oversee insider threat and counterintelligence investigations consistent with applicable government and corporate protocols.
* Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders for investigations and operations.
* Review investigative findings, ensure appropriate documentation and evidence preservation, and recommend corrective and preventive actions.
* Monitor metrics and trends to identify systemic risks, emerging issues, and opportunities for continuous improvement.


Insider Threat \& Risk Management

* Lead and administer the sector’s Insider Threat Program, while helping to shape and inform the company’s overall insider threat program through data, gap and trend analysis, and operational insights.
* Monitor and analyze security incidents and investigative trends to identify emerging risks, including insider threats.
* Develop and implement strategies to address potential threats, risks, and vulnerabilities.


Security \& Compliance

* Oversee investigations of security complaints and compliance concerns while ensuring consistent application of company policies, procedures, and standards.
* Interpret, apply, and ensure adherence to federal security regulations that govern company operations, including the National Industrial Security Program Operating Manual (NISPOM), DOD Manual 5205\.07 Special Access Program Security Manual, Federal Acquisition Regulations (FAR), and other applicable directives.
* Monitor regulatory changes and assist with updates to policies, procedures, and compliance programs.


Training \& Awareness

* Develop and deliver security education and awareness, and implement corporate investigations, insider threat, and counterintelligence programs across cleared and uncleared facilities.


Stakeholder \& Agency Partnerships

jobs.title: Aerospace Program Manager
jobs.description:
**About Us**

We are a full\-service aerospace design, development, manufacturing, and qualification test supplier supporting Tier 1 primes, government agencies, and commercial customers. For more than 50 years, we've partnered with innovators to develop deployable systems that push the boundaries of what's possible—in space, on the Moon, and beyond.

If you're a seasoned Program Manager who enjoys leading technically complex programs, building strong customer relationships, and collaborating with exceptional engineering teams, we'd love to talk to you.

**A Day in the Life**

We're looking for an experienced Program Manager to lead the successful execution of complex aerospace development programs from proposal through delivery. This role serves as the bridge between our customers and our cross\-functional engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, and leadership teams to ensure every program is delivered on schedule, within budget, and to the highest quality standards.

You'll work closely with engineers to understand technical challenges, proactively manage program risks, and keep customers informed throughout every phase of the program lifecycle. In our collaborative, fast\-paced environment, you'll have the opportunity to influence technical decisions, drive execution, and help bring innovative aerospace technologies to life.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead multiple aerospace development programs from contract award through successful delivery.
* Serve as the primary customer interface, providing regular program updates, leading customer meetings, and managing expectations throughout the program lifecycle.
* Build and maintain strong customer relationships while ensuring contractual commitments are achieved.
* Partner closely with engineering, manufacturing, quality, supply chain, finance, and executive leadership to execute program objectives.
* Develop and maintain integrated program schedules, budgets, milestones, resource plans, and risk mitigation strategies.
* Manage program cost, schedule, technical performance, and contractual compliance.
* Monitor technical progress and proactively identify and mitigate program risks.
* Ensure timely delivery of all customer contractual deliverables, including Contract Data Requirements Lists (CDRLs).
* Facilitate cross\-functional meetings to drive accountability, remove obstacles, and keep programs on track.
* Translate customer requirements into executable program plans and ensure alignment across functional teams.
* Support proposal development, program planning, cost estimating, and resource forecasting.
* Prepare executive\-level program reviews, metrics, dashboards, and customer presentations.
* Manage program changes, scope modifications, and customer change requests.
* Lead major technical reviews, including SRR, PDR, CDR, TRR, and customer milestone reviews.
* Ensure compliance with customer requirements, contractual obligations, quality standards, and company policies.
* Promote a collaborative, accountable, and solutions\-oriented program culture.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor's degree in Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical, Systems Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and aerospace experience.
* 10\+ years of Program Management experience within the aerospace or defense industry.
* Strong engineering background with the ability to understand complex technical designs, engineering discussions, and development challenges.
* Demonstrated success managing multidisciplinary aerospace development programs from proposal through delivery.
* Excellent customer\-facing communication, presentation, and relationship management skills.
* Experience managing program schedules, budgets, earned value, risks, deliverables, and contractual requirements.
* Strong understanding of engineering development lifecycles, manufacturing processes, and new product development.

At Pinkerton, the mission is to protect our clients. To do this, we provide enterprise risk management services and programs specifically designed for each client. Pinkerton employees are one of our most important assets and critical to the delivery of world\-class solutions. Bonded together, we share a commitment to integrity, vigilance, and excellence.

  

Pinkerton is an inclusive employer who seeks candidates with diverse backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives to join our network of industry subject matter experts.
